name: evidence-workbench
description: Evidence-based audits and workflows for scientific software, machine learning and research

plugins.name: workbench-core
plugins.description: Workflow core for any repository: planning, phase execution, minimal edits, handoffs, test and repository audits, decision records, repo setup and the profile guard

plugins.name: sim-validity
plugins.description: Simulation validity: run verdicts, solution and code verification, conservation, solver health, validation, mesh admission and derivative audits

plugins.name: ml-validity
plugins.description: ML validity: experiment leakage and splits, results provenance, third-party code and multi-fidelity data audits

plugins.name: research-writing
plugins.description: Research and writing: readable documents from agent notes, plain-language checks, evidence maps, claims ledger, LaTeX checks, analysis notes, documentation context, stop-slop and routing to research-papers

plugins.name: workbench
plugins.description: Install-only bundle: installs workbench-core, sim-validity, ml-validity and research-writing; each repository enables the ones it needs
